discovery_notes: Follow-up 2 to B006 (packets 206, 410), Disney Store US/UK/EU 2019. 30 standard WebSearches, excluded domains blocked, snippets only. Added Up 10th remaining 3 poster pins, Princess and the Frog 10th LE1500 set (5 Tiana pins), Sleeping Beauty 60th LE3550 set (3 pins), Little Mermaid 30th DS LR set (structure held), Dumbo live-action members (held, carried from 410), holiday pin details. All new members rest on single set lists and carry holds. No existing hold released. Shared US/UK sets use one dsus key with UK/EU release_location claims.
